title: MT-RewardTree: A Comprehensive Framework for Advancing LLM-Based Machine Translation via Reward Modeling
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2025
authors_zh: Zhaopeng Feng、Jiahan Ren、Jiayuan Su、Jiamei Zheng、Hongwei Wang、Zuozhu Liu
paper_type_zh: 机器翻译搜索偏好数据、过程奖励模型与评测基准
best_for_zh: 研究 token 级搜索数据、PRM、偏好学习、测试时对齐及 learned-metric 审计的读者
one_line: MT-RewardTree turns top-2 translation-token branches and three COMETKiwi-scored rollouts per node into 8,652 prefixed training pairs and a 1,200-pair benchmark, while releasing only selected pairs rather than the raw search trees.
MT-RewardTree 以 top-2 同前缀 token 分支和每节点三次 COMETKiwi 评分 rollout 构造 8,652 组偏好对及 1,200 组 benchmark，但公开数据只保留筛选后的 chosen/rejected，而不含原始搜索树。
why: It exposes a concrete recipe for converting token-level search and trajectory values into PRM preference supervision and reward-guided decoding, while showing that metric dependence, hidden rejected rollouts, split ambiguity, and unresolved source/model licensing can bound reuse.
inclusion_reason: MT-RewardTree releases token-level translation preference pairs and a benchmark built by top-2 sibling expansion, three-rollout COMETKiwi node valuation, and branch selection, making the search-to-preference construction contract directly relevant to rollout/search trace data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The final ACL Anthology record places MT-RewardTree in Findings of EMNLP 2025 (November 2025, pp. 18556–18567). The paper addresses a specific gap: machine-translation process reward models lacked a documented procedure for producing fine-grained token preferences and an MT-specific surface for testing whether a reward model ranks them correctly. It belongs in rollout_search_test_time_trace_data because each retained preference is selected through repeated translation rollouts, learned-metric scores, and token-branch search; the selector and budget are part of the data object rather than incidental inference settings.

For a source sentence from WMT17–WMT20 test data or FLORES development/test data, TowerInstruct-7B-v0.2 generates a shared translation prefix, the top-2 next-token siblings, and three complete EOS-terminated rollouts from each sibling. COMETKiwi-derived values select the superior branch. What the public prefixed release stores is narrower: instruction, input, chosen, rejected, chosen_score, and rejected_score. The corresponding benchmark omits input; the arbitrary variants compare completions that need not preserve the same sibling-prefix relation. Raw tree nodes, all six rollouts, discarded branches, explicit prefix/token identifiers, and averaged node values are not released.

This Card does not treat COMETKiwi labels as human ground truth, does not claim the unreleased search tree is reusable, and does not extend the paper to RL training—the authors leave RL integration to future work. L4 is supported by the final ACL paper, author project page, four official dataset repositories, and two model repositories; status remains partial because score semantics, raw-tree lineage, grouped splits, decontamination, code revision, and several licenses remain unresolved.

ACL Anthology 最终记录显示，MT-RewardTree 发表于 Findings of EMNLP 2025（2025 年 11 月，第 18556–18567 页）。论文针对的具体缺口是：机器翻译 process reward model 缺少一套有文档依据的细粒度 token 偏好生成流程，也缺少用于检验 reward model 能否正确排序这些偏好的 MT 专用评测面。它属于 rollout_search_test_time_trace_data，因为每条保留偏好都经过多次翻译 rollout、learned metric 打分和 token 分支搜索；selector 与预算是数据对象的一部分，而非无关紧要的推理参数。

对于来自 WMT17–WMT20 test data 或 FLORES development/test data 的一条源句，TowerInstruct-7B-v0.2 生成共享翻译前缀、top-2 下一 token 兄弟分支，并从每个分支采样三条以 EOS 结束的完整 rollout，再由 COMETKiwi 导出的 value 选择较优分支。公开的 prefixed release 更窄，只保存 instruction、input、chosen、rejected、chosen_score 和 rejected_score；相应 benchmark 不含 input，arbitrary variant 比较的完整翻译不要求保持同一兄弟前缀关系。原始 tree node、全部六条 rollout、被丢弃分支、显式 prefix/token 标识和平均 node value 均未发布。

本 Card 不把 COMETKiwi 标签视为人工 ground truth，不声称未发布的搜索树可以复用，也不把论文用途扩展为 RL training——作者将 RL 集成列为后续工作。最终 ACL 论文、作者项目页、四个官方 dataset repository 和两个 model repository 足以支持 L4；但由于 score 语义、原始树谱系、分组切分、去污染、代码版本和若干许可仍未解决，条目状态保留为 partial。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper’s central contribution is a search-to-preference interface for translation: compare two next tokens under the same prefix using the expected quality of their sampled completions, then turn the selected sibling contrast into pairwise data for an implicit PRM. In the approximate MCTS loop, the current prefix is the state and a next token is the action. The model expands only its top-2 logits, produces three full translations per child, assigns each child the mean COMETKiwi score of those rollouts, keeps the higher-valued branch, and repeats until EOS.

The construction feedback contract is judgment_required, not programmatic correctness. COMETKiwi observes a completed translation and emits a scalar quality estimate; it does not observe human intent, reference-grounded adequacy, the causal quality of an individual token, or whether a lower-probability branch outside the top-2 would ultimately be better. A prefixed pair operationalizes step-level supervision because chosen and rejected share the generated prefix and diverge at a sibling token, but the released schema does not expose that prefix or token in separate fields. DPO or KTO then derives an implicit token reward from policy/reference log-ratios rather than from human token labels.

The closest within-paper comparison is the arbitrary or “vanilla” pair variant, where two translations need not preserve the identical-prefix sibling contrast. MT-RewardTree changes the selection unit from sequence-only preference to a token-anchored branch decision backed by rollout values. Its research direction is therefore metric-guided search-to-process supervision for machine translation. The critical boundary is that the paper describes a tree-valued construction process while the release exposes selected pairs, not an auditable tree corpus.

论文的核心贡献是面向机器翻译的 search-to-preference 接口：在同一前缀下，用两个下一 token 各自采样补全的期望质量进行比较，再把选出的兄弟分支对转成用于 implicit PRM 的 pairwise data。在 approximate MCTS 循环中，当前前缀是 state，下一 token 是 action。模型只扩展 logits 最高的 top-2 token，从每个 child 生成三条完整翻译，以这些 rollout 的 COMETKiwi 均值作为 child 的 node value，保留 value 更高的分支，并重复到 EOS。

该构造的 feedback contract 是 judgment_required，而不是 programmatic correctness。COMETKiwi 观察完整翻译并输出标量质量估计；它看不到人的真实意图、基于参考译文的充分性、单个 token 的因果质量，也无法判断 top-2 以外的低概率分支是否最终更好。prefixed pair 的 chosen 与 rejected 共享已生成前缀，并在一个兄弟 token 处分叉，因此可作为 step-level supervision；但发布 schema 并未把该前缀或 token 作为独立字段暴露。DPO 或 KTO 随后从 policy/reference 的 log-ratio 导出 implicit token reward，而不是使用人工 token 标签。

论文内部最接近的对照是 arbitrary 或“vanilla”pair variant，其中两条翻译不要求保持相同前缀下的兄弟分支关系。MT-RewardTree 将 selection unit 从纯 sequence preference 改为由 rollout value 支持的 token-anchored branch decision，因此代表了机器翻译中的 metric-guided search-to-process supervision。关键边界在于：论文描述的是带 tree value 的构造过程，发布物却只有筛选后的 pair，而不是可审计的 tree corpus。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are source sentences from WMT17–WMT20 test sets and FLORES development/test sets in DE–EN, EN–DE, RU–EN, EN–RU, ZH–EN, and EN–ZH. The exact upstream versions, record IDs, and allocation manifests are undisclosed. TowerInstruct-7B-v0.2 is the generator, with temperature 0.95. The paper models translation as a deterministic token MDP: a generated prefix is the state, a token is the action, and EOS terminates a rollout.

For each selected prefix, the approximate MCTS pipeline expands the top-2 next tokens by model logits. From each sibling it samples three complete translations to EOS. COMETKiwi scores each completion, and the mean of the three scores becomes that sibling node’s value. The higher-valued sibling supplies the prefix for the next cycle. For data retention, the pipeline selects one rollout from the superior sibling and one from the inferior sibling and keeps the pair only when their COMETKiwi score gap is between 0.04 and 0.4. The number and identities of filtered-out candidates, search-depth distribution, maximum length, top-p, seeds, retry policy, and total compute are unknown (paper §3.1; §4.1; Figure 2).

The resulting training release has 8,652 records across the six directions. The prefixed and arbitrary repositories each expose one split named train with instruction, input, chosen, rejected, chosen_score, and rejected_score. MT-PRMBench has 1,200 records—200 per direction—and its prefixed and arbitrary repositories also expose a sole split named train, with the same fields except input. The public schema does not state whether the two scalar scores are retained-rollout COMETKiwi scores, three-rollout node means, or another export (Table 2; official Hugging Face viewers).

The authors train implicit PRMs with DPO or KTO and beta=0.1, using LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct and Qwen-2.5-3B-Instruct backbones. Their equations derive per-token process rewards from policy/reference log-probability ratios and aggregate weighted token rewards for sequence scoring. Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct is later paired with the trained PRMs for reward-guided test-time decoding; this is an inference-time application, not evidence of RL integration (§3.2; §4.1; §5.3).

Reproduction requires pinning the generator, PRM backbones, COMETKiwi checkpoint, paper/code/data/model revisions, and WMT/FLORES versions, then recovering the missing decoding, optimizer, split, and decontamination settings. The officially linked GitHub repository was identified, but its contents and license were not verified in the curation environment, so the Card does not claim an executable end-to-end replay.

输入是 WMT17–WMT20 test set 与 FLORES development/test set 中 DE–EN、EN–DE、RU–EN、EN–RU、ZH–EN 和 EN–ZH 六个方向的源句；确切上游版本、record ID 和分配 manifest 未披露。generator 为 TowerInstruct-7B-v0.2，temperature 为 0.95。论文将翻译建模为 deterministic token MDP：已生成前缀是 state，token 是 action，EOS 终止 rollout。

对每个选中的前缀，approximate MCTS 按模型 logits 扩展 top-2 下一 token，并从每个兄弟分支采样三条到 EOS 的完整翻译。COMETKiwi 为每条补全打分，三次得分均值作为该 sibling node 的 value；value 更高的兄弟分支成为下一循环的前缀。数据保留阶段从较优和较劣 sibling 各选一条 rollout，仅当二者 COMETKiwi score gap 位于 0.04 到 0.4 之间时才保留 pair。被过滤 candidate 的数量与身份、search depth 分布、最大长度、top-p、seed、retry policy 和总计算量均未知（论文 §3.1、§4.1、Figure 2）。

最终 training release 含六个方向共 8,652 条记录。prefixed 与 arbitrary repository 均只暴露一个名为 train 的 split，字段为 instruction、input、chosen、rejected、chosen_score 和 rejected_score。MT-PRMBench 含 1,200 条记录，每个方向 200 条；其 prefixed 与 arbitrary repository 同样只有一个名为 train 的 split，字段相同但没有 input。公开 schema 没有说明两个标量 score 是保留 rollout 的 COMETKiwi 分数、三次 rollout 的 node mean，还是其他导出值（Table 2；官方 Hugging Face viewer）。

作者使用 DPO 或 KTO 及 beta=0.1 训练 implicit PRM，backbone 为 LLaMA-3.2-3B-Instruct 和 Qwen-2.5-3B-Instruct。论文公式从 policy/reference log-probability ratio 导出 per-token process reward，并以加权 token reward 汇总 sequence score。之后，Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 与训练后的 PRM 组合用于 reward-guided test-time decoding；这是 inference-time 应用，并非 RL 集成的证据（§3.2、§4.1、§5.3）。

复现时需要固定 generator、PRM backbone、COMETKiwi checkpoint、paper/code/data/model revision 和 WMT/FLORES 版本，并补齐缺失的 decoding、optimizer、split 与 decontamination 设置。已确认官方链接指向 GitHub repository，但整理环境未能验证其内容与许可，因此本 Card 不声称可以端到端执行 replay。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On MT-PRMBench, Table 1 reports that MT-PRM-Qwen-2.5-3B obtains 0.660 token-level accuracy and 0.863 average prefixed sequence-level accuracy; the LLaMA-based PRM obtains 0.578 and 0.776. The benchmark contract is pairwise ranking accuracy: a reward model is correct when it scores the construction-selected chosen item above rejected. These results demonstrate behavior under MT-PRMBench’s COMETKiwi-derived labels, not agreement with human token judgments.

Table 3 isolates the pair-construction choice for the Qwen backbone. On token-level MT-PRMBench, DPO trained on token-level pairs scores 0.660 versus 0.574 for vanilla pairs; KTO scores 0.644 versus 0.562. Table 4 compares supervision forms and reports 0.66 average accuracy for preference supervision versus 0.52 for direct MCTS-value regression. The authors associate the weaker value result with noisy Monte Carlo estimates and values concentrated around 0.7–0.8. This is evidence that pairwise ordering worked better in the reported setting, not that the underlying metric values are unbiased.

For the test-time application, §5.3 and Figure 3 use Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct on 500 WMT23 cases in ZH–EN and EN–RU. The paper reports that LLaMA-PRM- and Qwen-PRM-guided decoding improve EN–RU XCOMET-XL over greedy decoding by 17.5% and 17.9%, respectively. The scope is a high-resource, automatic-metric evaluation; no human evaluation or low-resource validation is reported.

Artifact evidence is concrete but incomplete: official viewers show 8,652 rows in each training variant and 1,200 rows in each benchmark variant, while the model collection exposes two 3B PRM checkpoints. These counts establish release availability. They do not establish data quality, split independence, source-rights compatibility, calibration, or reproducibility of the unreleased search decisions.

在 MT-PRMBench 上，Table 1 报告 MT-PRM-Qwen-2.5-3B 的 token-level accuracy 为 0.660，prefixed sequence-level 平均 accuracy 为 0.863；LLaMA PRM 对应结果为 0.578 和 0.776。benchmark contract 是 pairwise ranking accuracy：当 reward model 给构造流程选出的 chosen 高于 rejected 的分数时，判为正确。这些结果证明模型在 MT-PRMBench 的 COMETKiwi 派生标签下的行为，不代表它与人工 token judgment 一致。

Table 3 针对 Qwen backbone 隔离了 pair construction 的影响。在 token-level MT-PRMBench 上，用 token-level pair 训练的 DPO 得分为 0.660，而 vanilla pair 为 0.574；KTO 对应为 0.644 和 0.562。Table 4 比较 supervision form，报告 preference supervision 平均 accuracy 为 0.66，direct MCTS-value regression 为 0.52。作者将较弱的 value 结果与 Monte Carlo estimate 噪声以及 value 集中在 0.7–0.8 附近联系起来。这支持“pairwise ordering 在报告设置中更好”，但不证明底层 metric value 无偏。

测试时应用见 §5.3 和 Figure 3：Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 在 ZH–EN 与 EN–RU 各报告设置使用 500 条 WMT23 样本。论文报告，LLaMA-PRM 与 Qwen-PRM 引导的 decoding 在 EN–RU XCOMET-XL 上相对 greedy decoding 分别提高 17.5% 和 17.9%。其适用范围是高资源语言和 automatic metric evaluation；论文未报告 human evaluation 或低资源验证。

artifact 证据具体但不完整：官方 viewer 显示两个 training variant 各有 8,652 行，两个 benchmark variant 各有 1,200 行，model collection 则公开两个 3B PRM checkpoint。这些数量能够证明发布物存在，却不能证明 data quality、split independence、source-rights compatibility、calibration 或未发布搜索决策的可复现性。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline inside the study is ordinary sequence-level or “vanilla” preference construction: sample complete translations and rank them without requiring a controlled divergence at one next token. Approximate MCTS, Monte Carlo completion scoring, COMETKiwi, DPO, and KTO are existing components. MT-RewardTree’s concrete change is their composition around a same-prefix sibling intervention: top-2 candidate tokens define the local contrast, three future rollouts estimate each sibling’s value, and the selected contrast becomes both training supervision and a benchmark instance.

This produces a more specific data object than a generic chosen/rejected translation pair. The prefixed pair is intended to isolate a token decision while holding its generated history constant, and the trained policy/reference log-ratio provides an implicit process reward for later scoring or decoding. The authors also introduce MT-PRMBench as an MT-specific reward-model benchmark and release prefixed/arbitrary training and benchmark variants plus two PRM checkpoints. “First MT-specific reward-model benchmark” is the authors’ claim; this Card does not independently establish priority.

For rollout/search trace research, the directionally important contribution is the explicit bridge from search budget and trajectory-value estimates to pairwise process supervision. It also exposes a useful negative boundary: the released artifact is a compressed projection of search, not the search trace itself. Before treating the work as a reusable tree-data recipe, a reader still needs tree/node IDs, all rollouts and values, selector yields, score semantics, pinned judge versions, and split/lineage manifests.

论文内部的 prior-work baseline 是普通 sequence-level 或“vanilla”preference construction：采样完整翻译并进行排序，但不要求两条结果在某个下一 token 处形成受控分叉。approximate MCTS、Monte Carlo completion scoring、COMETKiwi、DPO 和 KTO 都是已有组件。MT-RewardTree 的具体变化是围绕同一前缀下的 sibling intervention 组合这些组件：top-2 candidate token 定义局部对照，三个后续 rollout 估计每个 sibling 的 value，筛选出的对照同时成为训练 supervision 和 benchmark instance。

由此得到的数据对象比一般 chosen/rejected 翻译对更具体。prefixed pair 试图在保持已生成 history 不变的条件下隔离一个 token decision，训练后的 policy/reference log-ratio 则给出可用于后续 scoring 或 decoding 的 implicit process reward。作者还引入 MT-PRMBench 作为 MT 专用 reward-model benchmark，并发布 prefixed/arbitrary 的 training 与 benchmark variant 以及两个 PRM checkpoint。“首个 MT 专用 reward-model benchmark”是作者主张，本 Card 不独立确认其优先权。

对 rollout/search trace 研究而言，具有方向意义的贡献是把 search budget 与 trajectory-value estimate 明确连接到 pairwise process supervision。它也暴露出一个重要的负面边界：发布 artifact 是搜索过程的压缩投影，而不是搜索 trace 本身。在把该工作视为可复用 tree-data recipe 之前，仍需获得 tree/node ID、全部 rollout 与 value、selector yield、score 语义、固定的 judge 版本以及 split/lineage manifest。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Method limits begin with the search approximation. Expanding only the top-2 logits can miss a lower-probability token whose later translation is better, while three rollouts per child give a noisy node mean. The 0.04–0.4 score-gap filter changes the retained difficulty distribution by excluding very small and very large contrasts. Retaining the superior branch for the next cycle further couples future data to earlier metric errors. As a curator inference, COMETKiwi false positives can promote fluent but inadequate branches, and false negatives can remove valid alternatives; without human agreement or calibration data, their rates are unknown.

The judge is also part of the measurement stack. COMETKiwi assigns construction labels and reappears among downstream COMET-family metrics, creating partial circularity. MT-PRMBench therefore measures recovery of metric-conditioned preferences, not an independent human preference standard. Gemini-2.0-Flash and other learned judges used in related applications introduce additional version, prompt, language, and calibration dependence.

Release limits block full search audit. The public records omit raw trees, node/parent IDs, explicit sibling tokens and prefixes, all three rollout sets, variance, averaged node values, discarded branches, and rejection manifests. The meaning of chosen_score and rejected_score relative to node means is undocumented. Each repository exposes only a split named train; source-sentence grouping, prefixed/arbitrary linkage, duplicate control, decontamination, and downstream WMT23 overlap are not documented.

Reproducibility and rights are also incomplete. Exact WMT/FLORES versions and record IDs, generator/judge checkpoint revisions, seeds, maximum length, total compute, optimizer settings, and an immutable cross-artifact manifest are unknown. Dataset pages display Apache-2.0 metadata, but compatibility with WMT/FLORES source terms and generated-output rights is unresolved; the LLaMA PRM lacks a visible license, and the GitHub code license was not verified.

The authors explicitly limit the study to high-resource language directions and leave low-resource extension and RL integration for future work. Test-time evidence uses 500 WMT23 cases per reported setup and automatic metrics, without human evaluation. These limitations prevent benchmark performance from serving as proof of release quality or general multilingual validity.

方法限制首先来自 search approximation。只扩展 logits 最高的 top-2 token，可能错过后续能产生更好翻译的低概率 token；每个 child 仅三次 rollout，也会使 node mean 含有噪声。0.04–0.4 的 score-gap filter 会排除差异极小和极大的对照，从而改变保留样本的难度分布。下一循环只沿较优分支继续，还会使后续数据受到早期 metric error 的影响。作为 curator inference，COMETKiwi false positive 可能提升流畅但不充分的分支，false negative 可能删除有效替代；没有 human agreement 或 calibration data 时，其发生率未知。

judge 同时也是 measurement stack 的组成部分。COMETKiwi 负责构造标签，又出现在下游 COMET-family metric 中，因此存在部分 circularity。MT-PRMBench 衡量的是对 metric-conditioned preference 的恢复，而不是独立的人工 preference standard。相关应用中的 Gemini-2.0-Flash 及其他 learned judge 还会引入版本、prompt、语言和 calibration 依赖。

发布边界阻止了完整 search audit。公开记录没有 raw tree、node/parent ID、显式 sibling token 与 prefix、每节点全部三条 rollout、variance、平均 node value、discarded branch 和 rejection manifest。chosen_score 与 rejected_score 相对 node mean 的语义也没有文档。每个 repository 只暴露名为 train 的 split；source-sentence grouping、prefixed/arbitrary linkage、duplicate control、decontamination 以及与下游 WMT23 的 overlap 均未披露。

复现与权利信息同样不完整。确切 WMT/FLORES 版本与 record ID、generator/judge checkpoint revision、seed、最大长度、总计算量、optimizer 设置以及不可变的跨 artifact manifest 均未知。dataset page 显示 Apache-2.0 metadata，但它与 WMT/FLORES source term 和生成输出权利是否兼容尚未解决；LLaMA PRM 没有可见许可，GitHub code license 也未验证。

作者明确将研究限制在高资源语言方向，并把低资源扩展与 RL 集成留作未来工作。测试时证据在每个报告设置中使用 500 条 WMT23 样本和 automatic metric，没有 human evaluation。因此，benchmark performance 不能作为 release quality 或广泛多语言有效性的证明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned rollout/search/test-time trace track, MT-RewardTree is most useful as a worked search-to-preference recipe. A data builder can reproduce the module boundaries—source sampling, top-2 sibling expansion, three rollouts per child, COMETKiwi mean valuation, score-gap filtering, pair export—and then test alternative rollout budgets, selectors, human-calibrated metrics, or raw-tree retention. A verifier researcher can use MT-PRMBench’s prefixed versus arbitrary surfaces to ask whether a PRM ranks a controlled token divergence more reliably than unconstrained full sequences.

The released 8,652 pairs can support DPO/KTO or reward-modeling baselines only after checking upstream rights, exact revisions, duplicate/split linkage, score semantics, and the unavailable implementation details. The 1,200-pair MT-PRMBench can support evaluation experiments, but it should be treated as a COMETKiwi-conditioned benchmark and kept separate from training by an explicit source-sentence manifest. The PRMs can seed test-time decoding comparisons against greedy generation, provided COMET-family evaluation is supplemented with independent or human assessment.

The safe current reuse class is method and audit reference, with conditional—not unconditional—training or evaluation reuse. Raw search-trace reuse is blocked because the trees, per-node rollouts, and rejection records are absent. An especially useful audit checklist is to require search budget, selector version, node-value uncertainty, retained/failed candidates, grouped splits, license reconciliation, and judge calibration whenever a search-generated pair release is proposed.

对于指定的 rollout/search/test-time trace track，MT-RewardTree 最适合作为 search-to-preference 构造配方来研究。data builder 可以复现其模块边界——source sampling、top-2 sibling expansion、每个 child 三次 rollout、COMETKiwi mean valuation、score-gap filtering 和 pair export——再对替代 rollout budget、selector、经人工校准的 metric 或 raw-tree retention 做对照实验。verifier 研究者可以利用 MT-PRMBench 的 prefixed 与 arbitrary 评测面，检验 PRM 是否能比无约束完整 sequence 更可靠地排序受控 token 分叉。

公开的 8,652 组 pair 只有在核查上游权利、确切 revision、duplicate/split linkage、score 语义和缺失实现细节后，才适合用作 DPO/KTO 或 reward-modeling baseline。1,200 组 MT-PRMBench 可以支持 evaluation experiment，但应视为 COMETKiwi-conditioned benchmark，并通过显式 source-sentence manifest 与训练数据隔离。公开 PRM 可以作为 test-time decoding 与 greedy generation 的对照起点，前提是用独立评估或 human assessment 补充 COMET-family metric。

当前安全的复用等级是 method and audit reference；训练或评测复用是有条件的，而非无条件安全。由于 tree、per-node rollout 和 rejection record 缺失，raw search-trace reuse 仍被阻断。一个特别实用的 audit checklist 是：凡是 search-generated pair release，都要求披露 search budget、selector version、node-value uncertainty、保留与失败 candidate、grouped split、license reconciliation 和 judge calibration。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §3.1 and Figure 2 first: the reusable mechanism is top-2 sibling expansion, three EOS rollouts per child, COMETKiwi mean node values, and continuation from the higher-valued branch.
  • Keep construction and release separate: the paper uses a tree, but the public schema contains only chosen/rejected translations and two undocumented scalar-score semantics.
  • Read Tables 1, 3, and 4 together: benchmark ranking, token-level versus vanilla pairs, and preference versus direct-value supervision answer different questions and do not prove data quality.
  • Treat the 0.04–0.4 filter and sole train splits as audit decisions; selection yield, grouped source-sentence overlap, duplicate control, and decontamination remain unknown.
  • Pair this Card with other search-trace entries by comparing retained failures, verifier independence, and equalized rollout budgets—not by comparing final metric scores alone.

• 先读 §3.1 与 Figure 2：可复用机制是 top-2 sibling expansion、每个 child 三条 EOS rollout、COMETKiwi mean node value，以及沿更高 value 分支继续搜索。
  • 必须区分构造过程与发布物：论文使用 tree，但公开 schema 只有 chosen/rejected 翻译和两个语义未说明的标量 score。
  • 应合并阅读 Table 1、3、4：benchmark ranking、token-level 与 vanilla pair、preference 与 direct-value supervision 回答不同问题，都不能证明 data quality。
  • 应把 0.04–0.4 filter 和仅有的 train split 视为 audit decision；selection yield、按 source sentence 分组的 overlap、duplicate control 与 decontamination 仍未知。
  • 与其他 search-trace 条目联读时，应比较 retained failure、verifier independence 和等价 rollout budget，而不是只比较最终 metric score。

value.html: Offline token-level approximate MCTS over a deterministic translation MDP: select the current prefix, expand its top-2 next tokens, sample three EOS-terminated rollouts per child, score them, and continue from the higher-valued child.

COMETKiwi scores every completed rollout; the mean of three rollout scores is the node value used to compare siblings. The released pair exposes chosen_score and rejected_score, but the release does not document whether these are retained-rollout scores or averaged node values. DPO/KTO policy-reference log-ratios yield implicit per-token process rewards.
A rollout terminates at EOS. One rollout from each superior/inferior sibling is retained only when the COMETKiwi score gap lies between 0.04 and 0.4; the search cycle ends when EOS is selected.

items: COMETKiwi is both the construction judge and a recurring downstream metric, creating metric bias and partial circularity rather than independent human preference evidence.
Three-rollout Monte Carlo node values can be noisy; the paper reports narrow value clustering around 0.7-0.8 and weaker direct value-supervision accuracy.
Restricting expansion to the top-2 logits can exclude lower-probability tokens that lead to better translations.
Retaining only the higher-valued branch and a filtered sibling pair hides raw trees, discarded candidates, rollout variance, selector errors, and selection yield.
The score-gap filter of 0.04-0.4 changes the preference distribution and may remove subtle or extreme cases.
The benchmark inherits labels from the same generator/metric pipeline and upstream source mixture as training; grouped overlap and decontamination are undisclosed.
The arbitrary benchmark is materially harder and includes noisy partial translations; the paper reports lower average sequence-level accuracy of 0.628-0.668.
Test-time alignment evidence is limited to 500 high-resource WMT23 cases per reported setup and automatic COMET-family metrics; no human evaluation or low-resource validation is reported.
Gemini-2.0-Flash and COMET-family learned judges introduce prompt/model-version, calibration, language, and domain biases.
Final ACL authorship differs from the project/preprint, which also lists Zhihang Tang; downstream citation metadata should follow the final ACL record.
The LLaMA PRM lacks a model card/license badge, and code/data/model revisions are not bound by an immutable manifest.
